# Front Porch Growth

> Front Porch Growth sells two things to small and home-service businesses: Executive Receptionist, an AI receptionist that answers forwarded calls and website chat, and YardMailer postcard campaigns that show each homeowner a concept for their own property. Run by Cole Collins, who built it for his own lawn care business.

## Key facts: Executive Receptionist
- What it does: answers your business calls 24/7 when you forward your line to it, asks the questions you approve (name, callback number, address, what they need, how urgent), and emails you the lead.
- You keep your existing business number. Calls reach the receptionist by call forwarding from your phone.
- Channels: phone calls and a chat box for your website, both from one AI agent. Texting is available after setup.
- What it does not do: it does not quote prices you have not approved or give technical, legal, or medical advice. Booking during the call is optional: when the owner turns it on, it offers open windows from hours the owner sets and books one.
- Who it is for: HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, lawn care, landscaping, cleaning, pest control, and other home-service shops, plus dentists, law firms, med spas, and advisors (executivereceptionist.com).
- Try it: call the live demo line (256) 952-4935. It answers as Porchlight Heating & Air, a made-up HVAC company. There is also a browser demo at https://executivereceptionist.com/receptionist.
- Plans and the free trial are published on the pricing page: https://frontporchgrowth.com/pricing

## Key facts: YardMailer postcards
- Each postcard shows the homeowner an AI-made concept for their own home or yard, with a QR link to request an estimate.
- You approve the design, the audience, and the cost before anything is mailed.
- Setup and per-card prices are published on https://frontporchgrowth.com/pricing
